decisions.reason: The Pro plan without add-ons applies to the separately configured Zapier account, not the MeetAlfred subscription plan.
The Zapier subscription selection does not change the required HubSpot CRM configuration.
The source decision concerns Zapier and does not change Apollo account or browser-extension configuration.
Although this deferred synchronization uses Zapier, selecting the Pro plan without add-ons does not change its source, destination, integration method, scope, or lifecycle.
Zapier plan selection does not alter the requirement to include lead notes in HubSpot.
Zapier plan selection does not alter the HubSpot lead task-assignment requirement.
The current transfer path uses Apollo, and the source does not change its platforms, steps, timing, or subscription assumptions.
The Zapier account plan does not necessarily change the independently required automated email campaigns in MeetAlfred.
The Zapier account plan does not necessarily change the independently required automated LinkedIn campaigns in MeetAlfred.
The source does not establish any change to silent-lead recirculation, MeetAlfred export, or manual-cleanup behavior.
The Zapier plan selection does not resolve or change how existing CRM records should be shown to users.
The source does not change which communication channels must be visible in HubSpot lead records.
